posts.title: Hermes Agent on Azure: traces, logs and metrics in Azure Monitor with OpenTelemetry
posts.description: Running the open-source Hermes Agent on Azure Container Apps and sending its telemetry to Application Insights and an Azure Monitor workspace with the hermes-otel plugin: what the setup is, what Azure shows, and what broke on the way

posts.title: hn.fm, a year on: Hacker News as episodes, digests, a radio station and directed video
posts.description: A 2025 hackathon project that turned Hacker News stories into narrated video kept growing. This is what it does now, how each part works, and a set of things it made from one day's front page, all on models running at home.

posts.title: From Pokédex artwork to 3D models: every Pokémon, in clay, glass and chrome
posts.description: A 2025 side project turned 1,017 flat Pokédex drawings into 3D models and then sat on a hard drive. This is how it worked, what it took to bring it back, and what a restyle step, a review studio and a virtual film set add to it.
